meta.title: AHO for real estate agents — voice in, 21 social posts out, in one click
meta.description: Stop posting listings one platform at a time. Dictate a voice note, AHO turns it into a bilingual listing plus 21 platform-tuned social posts that all link back to you. Pro Automation $99/mo. Cancel any time.

hero.headline: Stop posting listings one platform at a time. Start advertising globally with one click.
hero.sub: Dictate a voice note as you leave the property. By the time you reach the car, AHO has a bilingual listing live and 21 social posts ready to publish — every one of them linking back to you.

problem.heading: What's eating your week
bullets: Same listing, four platforms, each demands a different length, tone, and hashtag style. Write it once and post badly — or write it four times and burn the day.
International buyers (Polish in Spain, Germans in Italy, Americans in DR) never see your listings because everything is in your local language only.
Industry data: agents spend 5–10 hours a week writing social posts. Most stop at one platform because doing four multiplies the work — and skips the 3–5× lead lift.

solution.heading: Voice in. Bilingual listing. 21 posts. 60 seconds.
solution.body: AHO is an intelligent content-distribution hub for real-estate professionals. Tap the mic, speak the property in your own language. Whisper transcribes, Claude extracts the structured facts, and your listing draft is on advertisehomes.online before you reach your car. Then one tap generates 21 platform-tuned, locale-native social posts — Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn × seven languages — every single one with your AHO listing URL embedded.

features.heading: Three things that make AHO different

items.title: Speak it
items.body: Voice-import for the on-the-move agent. Dictate a property in Polish, Spanish, English — Whisper transcribes, Claude extracts price, area, beds, location, amenities, and pre-fills your listing form. URL paste from otodom or idealista works the same way.

items.title: Sell it
items.body: One AHO listing URL embedded in every social post. Buyers click from Facebook, Instagram or LinkedIn and land on your page — and your contact form. Leads route into one AHO inbox you actually answer, instead of five DMs you miss.

items.title: Track it
items.body: Per-listing performance dashboard with real reach and lead numbers per platform per locale. The AI surfaces what's working: "Your IG-Reel variant in Polish is generating 3× more leads than the FB version. Keep using it."

howItWorks.heading: From voice note to 21 social posts in 60 seconds

steps.title: Speak the property
steps.body: Tap "New listing" on your phone and dictate: "Two-bed apartment, 50 m², close to Wilanowska metro, 850k." Or paste a competitor URL. Or fill the form yourself — your choice. AHO supports all three input modes.

steps.title: Review and publish
steps.body: AHO returns a pre-filled listing draft in under 30 seconds. Edit anything, add photos, hit Publish. Your listing goes live at advertisehomes.online with a permanent URL — bilingual content where both languages are written, single-language with a clear translation flag where they aren't.

steps.title: Generate 21 social posts
steps.body: Tap "Generate social posts." AHO produces 21 platform-tuned variants — three platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) × seven languages (EN/ES/PL/PT/DE/FR/IT). Each variant respects platform character budgets, uses native marketer voice for its locale, and embeds your AHO listing URL. Copy-paste today; one-click publish as Meta App Review approves.

features: Unlimited listings, voice + URL + manual import
21 social-post variants per listing (3 platforms × 7 locales)
Centralized lead inbox + per-listing performance dashboard
Cancel any time from the Stripe Customer Portal

items.q: How long does it take to set up?
items.a: Under 15 minutes from signup to your first listing live: 5 minutes to fill in your agent profile, 5 minutes to publish your first listing (or 30 seconds via voice), 5 minutes to copy your first batch of social posts. Connecting Facebook / Instagram for one-click publishing adds another OAuth click each — that piece ships once Meta App Review approves the integration.

If you can record a voicemail, you can use AHO. The voice flow is one button. The listing form is the same fields you'd write on paper. The social posts are pre-written — you just review and post. We answer support email at info@advertisehomes.online within one business day.

Yes. Cancel from the Stripe Customer Portal in two clicks — your access continues until the end of your current billing period and you keep your listings, leads, and analytics history. No retention call, no "reasons-to-stay" survey.

v1 generates posts for Facebook, Instagram (feed + Reels) and LinkedIn — three platforms across seven locales for 21 variants per listing. Today: copy-paste to your accounts. Soon (post Meta App Review): one-click publish to Facebook Page, Instagram Business, and WhatsApp Business. TikTok and YouTube Shorts are on the roadmap.

Worldwide. The platform is live with a soft-beta in the Dominican Republic and Poland — those are the two markets we're recruiting first agents from. Listings, agent profiles and city pages render in English and Spanish; the marketing surface (this page included) localizes to Polish, Portuguese, German, French and Italian so foreign buyers find you in their language.

items.q: How does the voice import work?
items.a: You speak in your native language — Polish, Spanish, English, any of the seven AHO locales. OpenAI Whisper transcribes the audio (it handles street names, square-meter values and real-estate jargon well). Claude reads the transcript and pulls structured facts: price, beds, baths, area, location, amenities, description. AHO then pre-fills the listing form. You review, edit anything that's off, hit Publish. Total time: typically 30–60 seconds for the AI portion, plus however long you take to add photos.

meta.title: Documentation — AHO
meta.description: Written guide for buyers, agents, and admins using AHO. Search, save, contact, list, distribute, moderate.

docs.heading: Documentation
docs.intro: Three audiences, three guides. Pick the one that fits how you use AHO. Every section links to the actual surface inside the product so you can follow along while signed in.

buyers.heading: For buyers
buyers.intro: You don't need an account to browse. You do need one to save searches, favorite listings, and contact agents. The whole buyer experience is free — agents pay to publish, buyers never pay AHO.

sections.title: Searching for a property
body: The search page is where most buyers spend their time. Type a city, neighborhood, or postcode in the search box, or pan and zoom the map — the list of results refreshes to whatever is currently visible on the map.
Filter by price, bedrooms, property type, and listing type (sale or rent). Prices show in the currency you've picked at the top of the page; the underlying value is the price the agent set.
Empty results are honest: when nothing matches your filters, the page tells you so. We never invent demo listings to fill space.

sections.title: Saving properties and searches
body: Tap the heart icon on any listing card or detail page to favorite it. Favorites stay attached to your browser even before you sign in; once you create an account, your anonymous favorites merge into your account so you don't lose them.

Saved searches are different: they're a stored set of filters that we re-run for you. Open a search you like, hit "Save this search," name it, and choose whether you want email digests when new matches appear. You can manage them — rename, edit filters, change digest frequency, delete — from the Saved searches page.

sections.title: Contacting an agent
body: Every listing has a contact form on the right side of the page (or below the photos on mobile). Fill in your name, email, optional phone, and a message; the agent receives it in their inbox and you receive a copy by email.

We forward your message to the agent and only the agent. We never sell or share contact details with third parties. The form is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile and a honeypot to keep bots out — you'll usually never see a challenge.
If you'd rather call or message on WhatsApp, the agent's profile page lists whatever direct channels they've added.

links.label: Browse listings to find an agent

sections.title: Language and currency
body: Switch the interface language from the toggle at the top right and bottom of every page. AHO ships in seven languages: English, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian. Listing content itself is written by the agent — it appears in whichever languages they wrote it in (typically English and/or Spanish at launch). We never auto-translate listing copy.

Currency is independent of language. Pick your preferred currency from the same area; prices reformat with live FX rates while the underlying listing price stays unchanged. Formatting follows your locale — €1.250.000 in Spanish, $1,250,000 in English.

sections.title: Account, security, and privacy
body: Create an account with email + password, Google, or a magic link. Password reset is self-service from the sign-in page. You can enable two-factor authentication (TOTP) from your dashboard — recommended if you save sensitive searches.

All your data is yours. You can delete your account at any time from the Profile page in the dashboard; this cascades to your favorites, saved searches, contact-form submissions, and reviews. Billing records (if you also use AHO as an agent) are anonymized but retained where tax law requires.
Read the full privacy policy for a line-by-line breakdown of what we store, why, and for how long.

agents.heading: For agents
agents.intro: Agents subscribe to publish listings. The lowest tier puts you on the platform; the higher tiers unlock the social-distribution automation that turns one listing into 21 platform-tuned posts. Everything below assumes you've signed up — see the pricing page if you haven't yet.

sections.title: First-time setup: subscribe, onboard, profile, first listing
body: Subscribe from the pricing page. You'll go through Stripe Checkout (test card or real card, depending on plan), then return to the welcome page where the onboarding wizard walks you through three short steps: organization details, your agent profile, and your first listing.

Skip any step you can't complete yet — you can finish later from the dashboard. The onboarding wizard exists to lower the cliff between "I just paid" and "I have a live listing," not to gate access to the dashboard.
After onboarding, your dashboard becomes the home base for everything else: properties, leads, social posts, analytics, billing.

sections.title: Three ways to add a listing: URL, voice, manual
body: URL import: paste a link from a competitor portal (otodom, idealista, others) and AHO scrapes the public fields, downloads the photos, and pre-fills the listing form. You review, edit, and publish.

Voice import: tap the mic on the new-listing screen and dictate the property in your own language. Whisper transcribes; Claude extracts price, area, beds, location, amenities; the form pre-fills. Designed for agents leaving a viewing — by the time you reach the car, the draft is ready.
Manual: the classic form. Type each field, drag photos in, write your description. Always available as the fallback when an import lane misbehaves on an unusual source.

sections.title: Photo guidelines
body: Originals upload to Cloudflare R2; AHO derives display variants on Cloudflare Images. Recommended originals are 2400px on the long edge or larger, JPEG or WebP, under 10 MB each. We accept up to 30 photos per listing.
Order matters: the first photo is the cover that appears in search-result cards and social posts. Drag to reorder from the listing edit page.

Per the platform's real-only data rule, only photos of the actual property are allowed. No stock photography, no AI-generated rooms, no "representative" images from a different unit. Listings violating this are removed by moderators without notice.

sections.title: Editing a listing
body: Open a listing from the Properties page in your dashboard. The edit screen mirrors the new-listing form: language tabs (EN / ES) on top, photo grid below, and structured fields for price, address, attributes, and bilingual descriptions.
Saves are immediate. Every save bumps the public listing's updated_at, which signals search and the social-distribution scheduler that the content is fresh.
Archive a listing when it's no longer for sale but you want to keep the history. Archived listings stay in your dashboard for 90 days, then are deleted unless restored.

sections.title: Lead inbox and routing
body: Every contact-form submission on one of your listings lands in the Leads inbox. Each entry shows the buyer's name, email, optional phone, the message, the listing they were looking at, and a one-click reply that opens your email client with the right subject pre-filled.

Lead routing rules let you forward incoming leads to colleagues based on listing tags or geographic area — useful once your team is more than one agent. Rules run on the server before the lead notification email is sent.
Empty inbox? It really is empty. We don't seed demo leads, ever.

sections.title: Social grid and tones
body: On Pro Automation, the Social page shows a 3 × 7 grid: three platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) by seven languages. For each new listing, AHO generates a platform-tuned, locale-native variant in every cell — 21 posts in total.
Each variant is editable. You can pick a different tone (warm, factual, hype, professional) per platform; we keep your last choice as the default for the next listing on that platform.

Posts include your AHO listing URL so leads route back to your inbox. Until Meta App Review approval lands, publishing is copy-paste; one-click publish lights up automatically once approval is granted on a connected channel.

sections.title: Performance dashboard
body: The Analytics page shows real reach and lead counts per listing, per platform, per locale. We aggregate from the Meta and LinkedIn insights APIs (where you've connected your accounts) plus AHO's own server-side click and contact-form tracking.
Numbers are honest: empty until there's data, and we never extrapolate. Per-listing analytics open from the Properties page or directly from the analytics overview.

sections.title: Connecting social accounts
body: Open the Social page and follow the "Connect Facebook," "Connect Instagram," "Connect LinkedIn" prompts. Each opens the platform's OAuth flow in a popup; on success, AHO stores an encrypted access token and the page/profile id you've authorized.

You can revoke a connection any time from the same page; the token is deleted immediately. We only request the scopes needed to publish your own listing posts and read their insights — no friend-list, no advertising-account access.
While Meta App Review is pending, the connect button still works for the copy-paste flow but the auto-publish toggle is disabled.

sections.title: Billing and plan changes
body: Manage your subscription from the Profile page in the dashboard. The "Open billing portal" button hands you off to Stripe's hosted Customer Portal where you can update card details, download invoices, switch plans, or cancel.
Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period — your listings stay live until then. Re-subscribing reopens everything where you left it.
Tax (VAT, sales tax) is handled automatically by Stripe Tax based on your billing country.

sections.title: Marking a listing sold and asking for a review
body: When a deal closes, open the listing and use "Mark as sold/rented." Enter the closing date, optional closing price, and which side you represented (buyer, seller, both). The listing moves to your sold archive and shows a "Sold" badge for 30 days.

If the buyer's email is on the deal, AHO can send them a one-click review request 7 days after closing. Reviews are double-verified: the email must match the deal record, and a tokenized link confirms it's the right person.

sections.title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP)
body: Enable TOTP from the Profile page. Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or any TOTP-compatible app, then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.

Once enabled, every sign-in asks for a fresh code. Save the backup codes shown on screen — they're the recovery path if you lose your phone. We can help you reset only with proof of identity; we cannot bypass MFA on a whim.

admins.heading: For admins
admins.intro: Admin access is granted manually by AHO and protected by mandatory MFA. The admin area lives at /admin and shows you the full picture across all organizations on the platform.

sections.title: Layout overview
body: The admin area is a simple top-nav layout. Left to right: KPIs, Moderation, Organizations, Users, Leads, Reviews, Audit log. Each section is a single page that loads server-side; there are no admin client apps to keep in sync.
Every admin action writes to the audit log. There is no off-the-record path.

sections.title: KPI strip
body: The home strip shows the headline numbers: active subscriptions per tier, listings published in the last 7 days, leads routed in the last 7 days, MRR, churn signals (pending cancellations).
Numbers are computed at request time from production data — no caching, no estimation. When something looks off, click through to the underlying screen rather than reloading.

sections.title: Moderation queue
body: New listings, edited descriptions with a high "unusual content" score, and reported listings land in the moderation queue. Each item shows the full listing as it would appear publicly, plus a sidebar of moderation actions: approve, reject with reason, suspend the agent.

Rejection reasons are templated (no real photos, duplicate listing, prohibited content, etc.) and surface back to the agent in their dashboard plus an email. Suspensions are immediate; the agent's listings hide from public view until lifted.

sections.title: Organizations, users, leads, reviews
body: Each is a list-with-detail screen. Filter and sort by the columns you need; click an entry to see the full record and the actions you can take. Org screen surfaces the agent's plan, billing status, listing count, and a button to open the Stripe customer in a new tab.
User screen lets admins reset MFA for a user who lost their device — only after identity verification, and the action is audit-logged.
Lead screen shows the routing decisions taken (which rule fired, who received it). Reviews screen shows reviews awaiting moderation and lets you approve, reject, or attach a moderator note.

sections.title: Audit log
body: Every admin write — approval, rejection, suspension, MFA reset, billing intervention — appears in the audit log with timestamp, actor, target, and a JSON payload of what changed. Filter by actor or target to investigate a single trail.
The audit log is append-only at the database level. Even admins cannot delete entries; the only way to correct a record is to add a compensating entry.

sections.title: Escalation paths
body: For anything you can't resolve in-app — payment disputes, legal requests, security incidents, suspected platform abuse — escalate to info@advertisehomes.online. Include the audit-log entry id (or the screen url and timestamp) so the on-call engineer can pick up your context immediately.
Security incidents follow the GDPR 72-hour clock: notify affected users within 72 hours of becoming aware, document the timeline, file the regulator notification.

leadRouting.heading: Lead routing
leadRouting.sub: Decide which agent receives an inbound lead based on the property's city, country, type, or the buyer's language. Rules run in priority order; the first match wins. No rule matches → the lead goes to the property's primary agent (the legacy behavior).
leadRouting.empty: No routing rules yet. Add one to start steering leads.
leadRouting.notManaged: You can view routing rules, but only the agency owner or a manager can change them.
leadRouting.actionRoundRobinUnknown: Round-robin (no agents selected — rule will skip)

agentGuide.metaDescription: Step-by-step guide for real estate agents. Subscribe → Connect Facebook → Publish a listing → Click Share. Your first post goes live in under 5 minutes.
agentGuide.heading: Share your listings on social media in 4 steps
agentGuide.subheading: A short manual. Most agents finish their first share in under 5 minutes from sign-up.
agentGuide.step1Body: Social automation is part of the $99/month Pro Automation plan. Lower plans show the feature but the publish buttons stay locked. Open the pricing page and pick Pro Automation. Payment is via Stripe — cancel any time from the Customer Portal.
agentGuide.step2Body: Open Dashboard → Social. Click Connect Facebook. Facebook will show a permission dialog asking for access to your Pages and any Instagram Business accounts linked to them. Click Continue. AHO never sees your Facebook password.
agentGuide.step2WhatP1: List the Facebook Pages you manage
agentGuide.step2WhatP2: Publish posts on your selected Page
agentGuide.step2WhatP3: Read post engagement (powers your analytics dashboard)
agentGuide.step2WhatP4: Detect Instagram Business accounts linked to your Page and publish to them too
agentGuide.step3Body: Dashboard → Properties → New. Fill the form (title, price, beds, baths, area, photos). Or paste a competitor portal URL and AHO auto-fills the fields. Click Publish. The listing goes live at a permanent URL on advertisehomes.online — that URL is what your social posts will link back to.
agentGuide.step4Body: Open the listing edit page. Scroll past the form and image uploader. You will see a "Share to my socials" card listing every Facebook Page and Instagram account you connected. Two buttons:
agentGuide.step4OptABody: AI proposes platform-appropriate captions you can read, edit, or replace before publishing. AI never publishes by itself — you are still the one clicking Share.
agentGuide.step4OptBBody: Publishes the post immediately to every connected account. Takes about 3-5 seconds. Multiple photos go to Instagram as a carousel automatically.
agentGuide.successHeading: What you will see when it works
agentGuide.successP1: Green ✓ for each Facebook Page and Instagram Business account
agentGuide.successP2: "View post →" link to the live post on each platform
agentGuide.successP3: Inside every post: the AHO listing URL — buyers click it and land on your property page
agentGuide.failureHeading: What to do if something fails
agentGuide.failureP1: A red ✗ row shows the platform that failed plus a short reason (for example, "image too large")
agentGuide.failureP2: Copy the short error reference on the row (it looks like AHO-SP-IMG-a3f7b2c1)
agentGuide.failureP3: Email info@advertisehomes.online — paste the reference, we look up the failure and reply
agentGuide.failureP4: Some failures are retryable — click "Retry failed" to try just the failed accounts. Successful posts are not duplicated.

profileLink.heading: Now: optimize your AHO profile for search
profileLink.body: Once you're publishing to social media, the next leverage is your AHO agent profile. Filling out 8 fields takes ~10 minutes and is how Google starts ranking you for "real estate agent in {city}".

agentProfileGuide.metaTitle: Get found on Google — fill your AHO profile right | AHO
agentProfileGuide.metaDescription: Profile-SEO guide for real estate agents. 8 fields, ~10 minutes. Google ranks complete agent profiles higher for "real estate agent in {city}" searches.
agentProfileGuide.heading: Get found on Google — fill your AHO profile right
agentProfileGuide.subheading: A short checklist. ~10 minutes. The agents who fill all 8 fields rank higher when buyers search "real estate agent in {city}" on Google.
agentProfileGuide.introHeading: What we emit to Google automatically
agentProfileGuide.introBody: Your public AHO profile at /agents/{your-slug} already includes structured data (Schema.org RealEstateAgent + AggregateRating + Review + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList). But the structured data is only as strong as what you fill in. Every field below maps to a schema property Google reads.
agentProfileGuide.field1Body: The exact form Google will surface in the search result. "Maria Rodriguez" beats "M. Rodriguez". This is your `name` schema property + the H1 on your profile page.
agentProfileGuide.field2Title: 2. Photo (real, head shot, eyes on camera)
agentProfileGuide.field2Body: Schema emits this as `image`. Buyers click profiles with a real face 3-5× more than profiles with no photo or a logo. No stock photos — buyers spot them instantly and they hurt trust.
agentProfileGuide.field3Title: 3. Bio (2-3 paragraphs, in your market language)
agentProfileGuide.field3Body: Mention your city or region by name. Mention your years of experience. Mention what makes you different (specialty: investment, luxury, first-time buyers). Google reads this as the most semantically rich text on the page; vague bios rank below specific ones.
agentProfileGuide.field4Body: Pick 3-5 from the list. Schema emits `knowsAbout[]`. Examples: "Luxury condos", "First-time buyers", "Investment properties", "Beachfront". Buyers also filter your profile by these tags.
agentProfileGuide.field5Body: Pick every language you speak professionally. Schema emits `knowsLanguage[]`. International buyers filter agents by language — a Polish buyer in Spain searches for Polish-speaking agents specifically.
agentProfileGuide.field6Body: WhatsApp is the primary lead channel in DR/LATAM (one click → conversation). Both appear as click-to-chat buttons on your profile. Schema emits `telephone`. Required field — buyers don't fill contact forms when they can WhatsApp instead.
agentProfileGuide.field7Body: Your personal or agency website. Schema emits `url`. Cross-domain link equity: a link from AHO's authority domain to yours helps your own site's ranking. Optional but worth filling.
agentProfileGuide.field8Body: Schema emits these as `sameAs[]` — Google uses them to confirm you're the same person across the web. Strong identity signal. Fill ALL the ones you have, even if you barely post on LinkedIn.
agentProfileGuide.publishHeading: What happens when you publish listings
agentProfileGuide.publish1: Each listing carries its own `RealEstateListing` JSON-LD that links back to you as the agent. More listings = more inbound JSON-LD signals to your profile.
agentProfileGuide.publish2: "Areas served" on your profile auto-derives from your listings' cities. Publish in your active areas; the profile updates automatically. No manual maintenance.
agentProfileGuide.publish3: Sales stats (active listings, sold count) appear on your profile and feed `aggregateRating` via the buyer-review flow after first lead.
agentProfileGuide.reviewsBody: After every first lead from a buyer, AHO emails the buyer a review-request link. Each published review adds a data point to `aggregateRating`. Google shows the star count in the SERP snippet — a 4.8 ★ profile beats a 4.0 ★ on click-through, all else equal. Encourage your buyers to leave reviews when you close.
agentProfileGuide.faqHeading: FAQ on your profile = SERP rich result
agentProfileGuide.faqBody: Add 3-5 FAQs on /dashboard/profile (FAQ editor at the bottom). Schema emits `FAQPage` and Google sometimes pulls FAQ answers directly into the search result page — high-value real estate. Questions like "Do you work with international buyers?" or "Which areas do you cover?" are perfect.
agentProfileGuide.ctaSub: You'll be on /dashboard/profile. Save changes — Google re-indexes within hours; visible rank improvements typically land within 1-2 weeks.
